validations.closest_work:
C3 · Conceptual Pacts and Lexical Choice in Conversation；支持 controlled human–human lexical reference 的 partner-specific historical effect；lexical reuse 不是 conceptual pact、population convention、multimodal convention 或 human–AI mutual belief 的充分证据。
C6 · Visual Resemblance and Interaction History Jointly Constrain Pictorial Meaning；支持受控 human drawing 中 history-sensitive recognition 与 diagnostic conventions；不证明 mutual belief、human–robot、abstract social meaning、cross-modal、long-term 或 transferable convention。
X13 · Benchmarking large language model agent societies against human behavioural distributions；Supports an LLM-agent diagnostic precedent, not human-equivalent convention formation, human–AI grounding, embodiment, or mutual belief.
X20 · Passing the Pact: Comparing Common Ground Building and Audience Design In Multiparty Human and Human-Agent Collaborative Communication；Supports a provisional speaker-behavior pattern in one multiparty reference task; it does not show that agents acquire, acknowledge, maintain, or repair conceptual pacts.
X22 · Which one is banana man? Evaluating vision–language models in multi-turn pragmatic interpretation；Shows that tested VLMs can retrieve externally available mappings yet struggle to bootstrap and repair them in this constrained overhearer task; it does not establish that all models cannot form conventions or that retrieval alone is grounding.
X23 · Using Machine Mental Imagery for Representing Common Ground in Situated Dialogue；Supports incremental multimodal state representation and retrieval on human-human dialogue traces, not mutual acceptance, agent-partner common ground, convention formation, or online human-agent co-adaptation.
X9 · Aligned but Not Partner-Specific: Distinguishing How Multimodal LLM Agents Succeed in Reference Games Without Human-Like Conventions；支持‘alignment/coordination 不足以证明 convention’，但不能推出所有模型或所有 training regimes 都缺乏 partner-specific grounding。
validations.support: 既有审议要求区分 pact reuse、knowledge-sensitive elaboration、acceptance 与 natural use。X22 提供 established-mapping retrieval 与 endogenous correction 的诊断分离；X23 提供状态表示组件。
validations.counterevidence: X20 已使“人不向 agent 复用 pact”失效；X22 已使“模型不能使用 convention”失效。X20 为摘要级；不能主张统计等价或 agent-side common ground。

validations.closest_work:

X4：一年后重访50名儿童的Leo记忆更新显示档案补全与短期亲近感部分回升；透明、用户主动编辑的Open-Memory仍是未来设计。
X5：该综述用agent、environment与association组织社会情境；它是概念与文献框架，不是证明情境效应或共同惯例的新实验。
validations.support: 记忆可能中介历史效应，不能要求排除所有memory；匹配信息、feedback、practice及一般视觉/状态追踪。
validations.counterevidence: X1已有动态WoZ指称，X2已有四角色比较，X3整套系统有效而记忆未独立识别，X4开放记忆未实测，X5是已有情境框架；不得宣称这些方向完全空白。
